article.detail:
TikTok於10月28日宣布Brand Safety Center、Brand Protection Playbook及AI Safety Essentials，並表示在新加坡APAC Responsible Media Forum介紹相關資源。

AI Safety Essentials由TikTok與Responsible Marketing Advisory合作制定，聚焦負責任的AI廣告創意。

公告將品牌保護分為安全環境、真實連結及清晰披露，並提及AI生成內容標籤。

品牌安全涉及廣告鄰接內容、創作者披露與AI內容標示，適合整合成同一份上稿前檢查表，而非只設定單一庫存篩選。

檢視現行Inventory Filter、排除清單及AI素材披露流程，向帳戶團隊確認可用資源與權限。

指南與平台控制不能保證零風險；本刊未將平台自報移除率或品牌信任數字當作獨立成效。
article.detail_en:
TikTok announced its Brand Safety Center, Brand Protection Playbook and AI Safety Essentials on October 28, presenting the resources at its APAC Responsible Media Forum in Singapore.

AI Safety Essentials was developed with Responsible Marketing Advisory for responsible AI advertising creativity.

The announcement groups protection into safe spaces, real connections and clear disclosure, including AI-generated content labels.

Brand safety spans ad adjacency, creator disclosures and AI labeling. Teams can consolidate these checks into a pre-publication workflow.

Review Inventory Filter, exclusion lists and AI creative disclosures, then confirm resource access with the account team.

Guidance and platform controls do not guarantee zero risk. Platform-reported removal and brand-trust figures are not treated as independent outcomes.
